title: A Cipher for the Witness
author: August Ashgrove
blurb: Kestrel Coldharbour, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
